preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 400.

preconditions.expression: all(4 <= n <= 2**16 and n & (n - 1) == 0 for n in ns)
preconditions.description: Each n is a power of 2 between 4 and 2^16.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= k <= n - 1 for n, k in zip(ns, ks))
preconditions.description: Each k is between 0 and n-1.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == '-1' or len(return_value[i]) == n//2 for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: For each test case, either the output is '-1' indicating no solution, or it contains n/2 pairs.

postconditions.expression: all(all(a in range(n) and b in range(n) for a, b in pairs) for n, pairs in zip(ns, parsed_return_values))
postconditions.description: Each element in the pairs is within the range [0, n-1].

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(a for a, b in pairs)) == n and len(set(b for a, b in pairs)) == n for pairs in parsed_return_values)
postconditions.description: Each element appears exactly once in the pairs.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(a & b for a, b in pairs) == k for k, pairs in zip(ks, parsed_return_values))
postconditions.description: The sum of bitwise AND of elements in each pair equals k.
